experiences.name: High Roller Observation Wheel
experiences.summary: A 550-foot observation wheel; one full rotation takes about 30 minutes. Allow at least an hour for entry and exit.
experiences.hours: Official page lists daily tickets from 12 p.m. to close; check the live hours calendar.
experiences.price: Adult daytime ticket $23.50 (12–5:59 p.m.); adult anytime ticket $34.75; Happy Half Hour $60 (21+). Taxes and fees apply.
experiences.forTwo: $47 for two daytime tickets or $69.50 for two anytime tickets, before taxes and fees.
experiences.note: Nevada residents receive 20% off standard tickets at the box office in January and June before 5 p.m. with valid ID; this is not a February offer.

experiences.name: The Mob Museum
experiences.summary: Four floors of organized-crime and law-enforcement history, immersive exhibits, and a separate speakeasy/distillery experience downstairs.
experiences.hours: Museum daily 9 a.m.–9 p.m. · The Underground Sun–Thu 11 a.m.–11 p.m.; Fri–Sat 11 a.m.–midnight. Hours can change; check early closures.
experiences.price: General admission $37.95 per adult; Deluxe $49.95; Premier $54.95. Online reservations are encouraged.
experiences.forTwo: $75.90 for two general-admission tickets at the listed price; upgrades, tax, and any extras are additional if applicable.
experiences.note: Ticket tiers and special-day hours may change. Confirm the chosen date on the official ticket page.

experiences.name: The Neon Museum · 2027 Admission
experiences.summary: Timed admission to the Neon Boneyard and Las Vegas sign collection; the museum recommends buying in advance because some nights sell out.
experiences.hours: Daily 3–11 p.m. for 2027 Admission; last admission 10 p.m. Seasonal ticket wording may vary, so check the target date.
experiences.price: 2027 adult admission from $21; a ticket processing fee applies.
experiences.forTwo: From $42 for two adults before the ticket processing fee.
experiences.note: The official FAQ says tickets are released 60 days in advance. Check the ticket calendar for the actual release date and availability.

experiences.name: Fremont Street Experience
experiences.summary: Pedestrian entertainment district with the Viva Vision canopy and free live entertainment on its stages; individual venues and add-ons may charge.
experiences.hours: Check the official calendar for current event times and any access notices.
experiences.price: Entry and the listed street-stage entertainment are free; food, drinks, and other attractions are extra.
experiences.forTwo: Free entry for two; optional purchases are not included.
experiences.note: The calendar reviewed did not establish a February 2027 performance lineup. Recheck closer to travel.

experiences.name: Sphere · The Wizard of Oz
experiences.summary: The official FAQ describes the experience as about 75 minutes. Doors open 45 minutes before ticket time; late seating is not permitted; recommended for ages 6+.
experiences.hours: Show dates and start times vary. A specific Feb 15–18, 2027 screening was not confirmed in the reviewed calendar.
experiences.price: No confirmed ticket price for the preferred dates in this research snapshot.
experiences.forTwo: Not priced for the target dates; check the live show and ticket calendar.
experiences.note: The Sphere show page displayed a Metallica residency range of Jan 28–Mar 13, 2027, overlapping the preferred date window. Confirm the exact performance date and ticket price before planning around it.
